metadata.title: Rigidity of conformal metrics with constant sixth-order $Q$-curvature
metadata.abstract: Let $(M^n,g_0)$ be a closed connected Einstein manifold with positive scalar curvature, where $n\ge6$. Using an Obata-type identity, we prove that every smooth metric conformal to $g_0$ with constant sixth-order $Q$-curvature is Einstein.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 六阶 Q-curvature 的 conformal 刚性
analysis.workSummary: 对 n≥6、正 scalar 的 closed connected Einstein 背景，用 Obata 型 identity 证明同 conformal class 中 constant sixth-order Q-curvature 的 smooth metric 仍 Einstein。
analysis.breakthrough: 把经典 conformal Einstein 刚性推进至六阶曲率。
analysis.limitations: 背景必须 Einstein 且 scalar 正，结论不是所有 constant Q₆ metric 均 Einstein。
analysis.priorityReason: 把经典 conformal Einstein 刚性推进至六阶曲率。
